mkdir no-config
cd no-config
exec git init -b main
exec sh -c 'printf "existing-pattern\n" > .git/info/exclude'

# A missing config stays absent while the explicit prefix persists in the
# initialized project database.
exec card --json init --no-config --prefix local-
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/no-config-init.json
! exists .cardamom/config.yaml
exists .cardamom/board.sqlite3
exec card create 'Persisted prefix'
stdout '^local-[a-z2-7]+$'
cmp .git/info/exclude $WORK/golden/exclude

# The removed flag is rejected by command parsing.
! exec card init --stealth
stderr 'unknown flag.*--stealth'
cd ..

# --no-config preserves and uses an existing store configuration.
mkdir existing-config
cd existing-config
exec git init -b main
mkdir .cardamom
cp $WORK/golden/existing-config.yaml .cardamom/config.yaml
exec card --json init --no-config
cmp .cardamom/config.yaml $WORK/golden/existing-config.yaml
exec card create 'Existing prefix'
stdout '^existing-[a-z2-7]+$'
cd ..

# An explicit prefix updates an existing project's database configuration when
# config.yaml is absent.
mkdir retained-store
cd retained-store
exec git init -b main
exec card init --prefix old-
exec rm .cardamom/config.yaml
exec card --json init --no-config --prefix new-
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/retained-init.json
! exists .cardamom/config.yaml
exec card create 'Updated prefix'
stdout '^new-[a-z2-7]+$'

-- golden/no-config-init.json --
{"dir":".cardamom","id_prefix":"local-","id_strategy":"random","schema_version":20260726181403,"config_written":false,"db_written":true,"project_created":true,"project_id":"project_00000000000000000000","project_name":"no-config","board_created":true,"board_id":"board_00000000000000000000","board_name":"no-config","already_initialized":false}
-- golden/exclude --
existing-pattern
.cardamom/board.sqlite3*
.cardamom/blobs/
-- golden/existing-config.yaml --
version: 1
issue:
  id:
    prefix: existing-
-- golden/retained-init.json --
{"dir":".cardamom","id_prefix":"new-","id_strategy":"random","schema_version":20260726181403,"config_written":false,"db_written":false,"project_created":false,"project_id":null,"project_name":null,"board_created":false,"board_id":null,"board_name":null,"already_initialized":true}
